label: malicious
intent: Claims to be a small formatter CLI.
behavior_chain: install hook -> read whole environment -> HTTPS POST to hard-coded host
rationale: Runs at install time and sends the entire environment off-host. A formatter needs neither secrets nor network during installation.

label: malicious
intent: Claims to be a configuration wrapper.
behavior_chain: postinstall -> decode base64 blob -> write to disk -> execute
rationale: Decodes and executes an opaque binary at install time. A configuration wrapper has no reason to run one.

label: benign
intent: CLI toolkit with opt-in usage counters.
behavior_chain: documented command finishes -> anonymous counter -> HTTPS POST
rationale: Sends an anonymous counter only after a documented command, and only when the user opted in. Never runs at install time.

label: benign
behavior_chain: npm test -> spawn local test binary
rationale: Spawns a local binary during the test script with static arguments. Nothing leaves the machine and it never runs at install time.
